grounded.summary: The overall verdict is fail. Three criteria passed automatically: mobile-friendly landing page, Lighthouse performance of at least 90, and site availability. The blocking criterion 'contact_form_works' failed: the form was found on the page, but no submission reached the test sink, and the success text 'Thank you' was not seen. The blocking criterion 'website_accessible' was not measured by any tool and still awaits an authorized human reviewer. The work is therefore not verified as complete.

explanations.explanation: At a 390x844 viewport the page returned HTTP 200 and scroll_width (390) equaled viewport_width (390), so there was no horizontal overflow. No required visible selectors were configured, so none were checked.

The form was found and no expected fields were missing, but sink_requests was empty, sink_receipts_in_db was 0, and the success text 'Thank you' was not seen (reason code NO_SUBMISSION_TO_SINK). No prohibited or unrelated blocked requests were recorded. The measurements do not show why no request was sent. Possible causes include the submit button not triggering submission, client-side validation blocking it, a JavaScript error, or the form posting somewhere other than the test endpoint. The screenshot taken after submit may help, but its content is not described in the measurements.
explanations.remediation: Make sure clicking button[type=submit] inside the form actually sends the submission to the configured test endpoint. Check the browser console for JavaScript errors and for validation that blocks submission with the sample values. Verify that the form action or fetch/XHR handler targets the test endpoint. After a successful submission, display the text 'Thank you'. Then re-run the check.

The root path returned HTTP 200 with no redirects in 56 ms. The tested URL was http://127.0.0.1:8020/landing-page-broken/, and HTTPS was not required for this check.
